visual_goal: Show a finance hub strangling source ledgers two ways: replicated postings through mapping, and business events through a rules engine, with a source ledger retired only after reconciliation proves equality over several closes.
prompt: A left-to-right illustration. At the far left, one soft grey panel labeled 'Source systems' holds three stacked generic server boxes labeled 'Wayfare ledger', 'Tablekin ledger' and 'SFP subledger'. Next, two processing boxes: on top a box with crossing arrows labeled 'Mapping', below it a box with gears labeled 'Rules engine'. One arrow from 'Wayfare ledger' into 'Mapping' and one arrow from 'Tablekin ledger' into 'Mapping'; a lightning-bolt arrow labeled 'events' from 'SFP subledger' into 'Rules engine'. In the center, a large open book labeled 'Group core ledger', receiving one arrow from 'Mapping' and one from 'Rules engine'. To the right of the book, a balance scale labeled 'Reconciliation', with one arrow from the book into it, and from the scale one green arrow up to a closed padlocked server box labeled 'Retired'. Below the scale a document stack labeled 'Reporting' with one arrow from the book. Exactly eight arrows.
alt: Three source ledgers feed a group core ledger, two through mapping of replicated postings and the custom subledger through events into a rules engine; reconciliation against the core leads to retiring a source ledger, and the core feeds reporting.

visual_goal: Show the 2025 agency displacement: SFP keeps commission rating, an interceptor routes agency partners to FI-CA and merchant partners to SFP invoicing, and a legacy mimic feeds FI-CA results back into SFP statements so partners see no change.
prompt: A left-to-right flow illustration in one straight chain at the start: at the far left a box labeled 'Booking platform', one arrow right into a box with a calculator labeled 'Commission rating', and one arrow right from 'Commission rating' into a railway-switch junction labeled 'Interceptor'. These three sit on one horizontal line, each connected only to its neighbour. From the junction two tracks: the upper track goes to a box labeled 'FI-CA invoicing', the lower track goes to a box labeled 'SFP invoicing'. From 'FI-CA invoicing' one arrow down into a box with a theatrical mask icon labeled 'Legacy mimic'. From 'Legacy mimic' one arrow right into a screen labeled 'Partner statements', which also receives one arrow up from 'SFP invoicing'. A calm unlabeled partner figure looks at the screen. At the far right an open book labeled 'General ledger' receives one arrow from 'FI-CA invoicing' and one arrow from 'SFP invoicing'. The 'Interceptor' and 'Legacy mimic' have orange dashed outlines, marking them as transitional.
alt: Booking events flow to commission rating and an interceptor that routes agency partners to FI-CA invoicing and merchant partners to SFP invoicing; a legacy mimic feeds FI-CA results into partner statements, and both invoicing paths post to the general ledger.

visual_goal: Show the EBS archive decommissioning as stepping stones, with a failed retrieval drill sending the plan back to extraction, and records leaving the archive only after retention ends with no hold.
prompt: A left-to-right path of six rounded stepping stones across a light background: 'Read-only', 'Extracted', 'Retrieval drills', 'Access removed', 'Shut down', 'Archive'. Single arrows connect each stone to the next. Small icons sit on the stones: a lock on 'Read-only', a stack of files with a check mark on 'Extracted', a magnifying glass over files on 'Retrieval drills', a key with a cross on 'Access removed', a power button on 'Shut down', an archive box on 'Archive'. One red curved arrow labeled 'drill fails' loops from 'Retrieval drills' back to 'Extracted'. After 'Archive', one final arrow leads to a small hourglass labeled 'Retention ends'.
alt: Stepping stones from read-only through extracted, retrieval drills, access removed and shut down to the archive, with a failed drill looping back to extraction and records leaving only when retention ends.
